_meta.review_notes: Supplemental EXPLAIN (tests/fixtures/17_implicit_cast.txt) used because the ogagila optimizer always picks an IndexScan on PK for the cast queries surveyed (Q44-Q47, Q132), but TYPE-001 only triggers on SeqScan nodes. Fixture 17 was purpose-built for this rule. Plan: single SeqScan on orders (est rows=100000, actual rows=500) with Filter: (status = '42') and Rows Removed by Filter: 500000. TYPE-001 fires via the BareColumnStringLiteral variant: extract_column_from_filter strips outer parens and returns column='status'; detect_asymmetric_cast finds no symmetric ::type on either side of '=' and Pattern 1 (status\)*\s*=\s*'([^']+)') captures '42', which parses as f64 -> mismatch=MismatchPattern::BareColumnStringLiteral. Threshold checks pass: rows_removed=500000 > 10, removal ratio=500000/500500 ~= 0.999 > 0.5. detail = t!('finding.TYPE-001.detail', filter='(status = \'42\')', desc=t!('finding.TYPE-001.desc_bare_col', col='status', val='42')="status = '42' (column vs string value)", removed=500000_i64, total=500500_i64) = "Seq Scan with filter '(status = '42')' (status = '42' (column vs string value)), filtered out 500000 rows (total 500500) — suspected implicit type cast preventing index usage". suggestion = t!('finding.TYPE-001.suggestion_bare_col', col='status', val='42') = "WHERE status = 42 — suspected numeric column compared with string literal, consider removing quotes or adding explicit cast". severity=Critical (per SuspectedImplicitTypeCast::severity()), category=TypeMismatch. SCAN-004 co-fires on the same SeqScan: has_filter=true, estimated.plan_rows=100000 > 0, actual.rows=500 > 0, ratio=100000/500=200 > estimation_ratio (default 10) so should_fire=true. extract_filter_columns captures 'status'. detail = "Seq Scan on orders with Filter: estimated 100000 rows but got 500 (ratio: 200x), Rows Removed by Filter: 500000". suggestion = suggestion_with_cols: "ANALYZE orders; also consider CREATE INDEX ON orders (status)". SCAN-001 does NOT fire (has_filter=true -> bails at scan_rules.rs:53-55; pure full scans only). TYPE-004 does NOT fire (no LIKE/~~ operator, just '='). GEN-001 does NOT fire (plan depth = 1, default threshold = 10). JOIN-001 does NOT fire (no Nested Loop node, no join at all).

anti_findings.reason: SCAN-001 (LargeTableFullScan) only fires on pure full scans; fixture 17's SeqScan has a Filter property so SCAN-001 bails at scan_rules.rs:53-55 and delegates to SCAN-004.
TYPE-004 (LikeWithLeadingWildcard) requires LIKE/~~ operator in the Filter; fixture 17 uses 'status = \'42\'' (equality), not LIKE.
GEN-001 (PlanTooDeep) fires when plan depth exceeds default threshold 10; fixture 17 is a single SeqScan (depth=1).
JOIN-001 (NestedLoopOnLargeTables) requires a Nested Loop node; fixture 17 has no join at all (single scan).
